facts.assertion: Havering Full Council approved adoption of the Havering Local Plan on 17 November 2021.
Havering lists the Local Plan 2016-2031 adopted in 2021 as a current adopted Development Plan Document.
Havering lists Policies Map North 2021 as a current adopted development-plan map.
Havering lists Policies Map South 2021 as a current adopted development-plan map.
Havering lists Site Specific Allocations 2008 as a current adopted Development Plan Document.
Havering lists Site Specific Allocations in the Romford Area Action Plan 2008 as a current adopted Development Plan Document.
Havering states its current Local Plan was adopted in 2021.
Havering says the 2021 Local Plan requires an update following the examination inspector's request for an immediate review.
Havering says the update must reflect national and regional policy changes and identify sites suitable for new homes.
Havering identifies Reviewing and collecting evidence as the current Local Plan update stage.
Havering lists Draft Local Plan consultation, also called Regulation 18, as the next plan-making stage after current evidence review.
Havering lists Regulation 19 consultation after review of Regulation 18 responses.
Havering lists submission to the Secretary of State after Regulation 19 consultation.
Havering lists examination, Inspector report and adoption as later stages after submission.
Havering says evidence-base documents will be published as they are produced.
Havering identifies a Strategic Housing Market Assessment among the Local Plan update housing evidence.
Havering identifies an Employment Land Review among the Local Plan update evidence.
Havering identifies open-space, sport, retail and town-centre evidence studies for the update.
Havering says its current Local Development Scheme was approved in April 2025 and covers 2025-2027.
The Havering LDS describes the Local Plan 2016-2031 and Policies Map 2021 as existing adopted planning policy documents.
The Havering LDS says the Site Specific Allocations DPD 2008 sets specific allocations across the borough except Romford and waste sites.
The Havering LDS says the Romford Area Action Plan 2008 contains specific allocations within Romford.
The Havering LDS says Site Specific Allocations DPD 2008 is to be revoked upon adoption of the Local Plan update.
The Havering LDS says Romford 2008 site allocations are to be revoked upon adoption of the Local Plan update.
The Havering LDS states the Local Plan update will include updated site-specific allocations.
Havering's monitoring report says the review of the adopted Local Plan is underway.
Havering's monitoring report says evidence-base work for the Local Plan update is underway.
Havering's monitoring report states the Site Specific Allocations DPD 2008 remains in place while the update is underway.
Havering's monitoring report states the Romford Area Action Plan site allocations remain in place while the update is underway.
The GLA Havering FeatureServer exposes Retained Site Specific Allocations as layer 20.
The GLA Havering FeatureServer exposes Romford Site Allocations as layer 22.
The GLA Havering FeatureServer exposes Metropolitan Green Belt as layer 14.
The GLA Havering FeatureServer is query-capable and uses EPSG:27700.
